text:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick request for the cost model: we need VoltCloud's capacity/price matrix and a short historical spot-price series. Prefer CSVs. Aim for per-SKU, per-region weekly buckets and commit-tier rows.
Ravi (VoltCloud Sales): On it. Do you want commit tiers 1/3/6/12/24 months? And should cross-region (late-bind) reserves be broken out separately?
Maya (Partnerships): Please include 1/6/12/24. Flag cross-region/late-bind SKUs with a boolean and max_regions. Also include an explicit guaranteed minimum (vGPU hrs/month) per commit tier.
Noah (Finance): Add these columns explicitly: net_effective_price_usd_per_hr (after rebates), spot_discount_pct, overage_price_usd_per_hr, early_termination_pct_fee, billing_granularity (hour/minute), currency. We'll normalize to USD/hr but need raw values.
Lina (Ops): We need maintenance_blackout (recurring windows), az_coverage (count), supports_live_migration (true/false), and any placement_group constraints. That feeds rollout planning.
Diego (Eng): From eng side: eviction_rate_per_1k_vgpu_hours, preempt_notice_min, eviction_retry_limit, latency_slo_delta_ms, and please attach 30 sample raw spot price points (timestamp,price_usd) and a small eviction event log (date,sku,region,duration_min,reason) for last 90 days so we can simulate.
Ravi (VoltCloud Sales): Example CSV header I'll include in the README so you can confirm before I ship the full set:
```
sku_id,sku_label,region,commit_tenor_months,guaranteed_vgpu_hrs_per_month,net_effective_price_usd_per_hr,spot_floor_usd_per_hr,spot_discount_pct,early_termination_fee_pct,billing_granularity_seconds,currency,late_bind_bool,late_bind_max_regions,az_coverage,supports_live_migration,eviction_rate_per_1k_vgpu_hours,preempt_notice_min,eviction_retry_limit,latency_slo_delta_ms,maintenance_blackout,notes
VC-A100-40,volt-a100-40,us-central1,12,120000,1.95,0.50,74,5,3600,USD,false,0,3,true,1.2,10,2,5,"Sun 02:00-03:00 UTC","volume rebate kicks in at 1M hours"
VC-H100-80,volt-h100-80,eu-west1,24,240000,3.45,0.80,77,3,3600,EUR,true,4,4,false,0.6,15,3,3,"Wed 01:00-04:00 UTC","cross-region reserved eligible"
```
Ravi (VoltCloud Sales): I'll upload a tarball with: capacity_matrix.csv, spot_series_120d.csv.gz, eviction_events_sample.csv, and README.md to our shared bucket: https://storage.voltcloud.com/partners/ingest.
UploadBot: File uploaded: vc_capacity_and_spot_2026-03-20.tar.gz (https://storage.voltcloud.com/partners/ingest/vc_capacity_and_spot_2026-03-20.tar.gz)
Ravi (VoltCloud Sales): A few notes: net_effective_price is post-volume and term rebates; spot_floor is our static floor in USD; spot_series contains market-level prices sampled hourly; eviction_event log contains anonymized customer IDs.
Maya (Partnerships): Great, thanks. Please ensure README maps sku_id -> customer_facing_name and lists the exact column datatypes and units.
Noah (Finance): After we ingest, I want the raw CSVs and a converted table normalized to USD/hr. I'll schedule a 45m sync to walk through anomalies.
Lina (Ops): When you upload, include recurring maintenance calendar in iCal or a simple weekly schedule so we can slot deployments.
Diego (Eng): If possible include a short sample of prefetched KV-cache warmup latency for each SKU (ms) so we can model cold-start token cost. Even 5 samples per SKU helps.
Ravi (VoltCloud Sales): Will compile everything and aim to deliver within 48 hours. Ping me @ravi for any fast clarifications.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks all :pray: We'll validate and loop back with any normalization asks.
